Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to retrieve the correct film information from IMDb and Vudu. The conversation concludes with an incorrect answer, stating "The Story of Adele H." as the highest-rated film under 2 hours available on Vudu, when the correct answer is "Nosferatu the Vampyre." This error occurred during the initial data-gathering phase, leading to an incorrect solution.
